customer: Caller, a new parent in Dunmore selling their electric car, rambled a bit about sleepless nights before asking what personal stuff they should clear out of the car first, mentioning a toll tag, the garage opener and their phone being connected to it.
agent: Customer asked what to remove before selling their electric car. Referred to the article 'Toll tags, garage codes and paired phones' and advised them to remove toll tags and parking stickers, clear garage door codes and unpair their phone from the car's system. Also advised that if the car has a connected-car app, they should remove the car from their account so the next owner can't see their data, and pointed them to 'Deleting your Northwind account' if they want Northwind to delete the personal data it holds about them.
